$comment: ADR-0067 reference example of flag-as-code. The real per-service files live in the gitops repo, are synced to a ConfigMap by ArgoCD (ADR-0010) and hot-reloaded by the flagd sidecar. Standard flagd schema, extended with an `openbank` block per flag carrying the governance metadata modelled by libs/flags FlagDefinition.kt. A CI gate (follow-up) parses every flag and runs FlagDefinition.validate().

openbank.description: Route SEPA instant payments through the new corridor router.
Customer-facing AI assistant (ADR-0089). Off by default; READ tools land Phase 1, ACTION tools (payment/card-freeze/dispute) Phase 2 behind HITL + SCA. Money-path flip is four-eyes.
Dark theme for the operator console — UI only, no behavioural risk.
